# Social Dance Lessons
Step into mixed reality and learn at your own pace with step-by-step guidance through lessons of various dance styles, such as Waltz, Cha-cha, Salsa and Bachata .  Practice as often as you like, and repeat lessons until you feel confident. Discover the joy of ballroom and social dancing, right from the comfort of your own home.  The beginner lessons are free and advanced lessons will be released as IAP through Q1 and Q2 of 2026.
[media]
# Virtual Dance Partner
Your Virtual Dance Partner is always there for you, guiding each lesson, practicing by your side, and helping you master every routine. With natural hand interaction, you can lead her into chasse steps, graceful turns, and more. 
[media]
# Competitions and Rewards
Once you’re ready, put your skills to the test in dazzling “Dancing with the Stars”–style competitions. Earn scores from virtual judges, climb the global leaderboards, and unlock rewards to build a wardrobe of elegant dresses and costumes, preparing you for your next big dance. [media]
# Bachata Bronze Lesson Pack Update!
We just released the Bachata Bronze course, with 11 essential dance figures and 9 routines~ Get the Launch Special Discount now! [media]
# Awards & Recognitions
- Winner of Meta Presence Platform Hackathon 2024
- Meta Start Lifestyle RFP Grant Recipient 2025
- Winner of Unity Taiwan Special Award 2025  
# Join our Discord and help us improve! 
https://dsc.gg/danceguru
